editor.notes: Walker and NPC sprites for the map sandbox: shapes only (the NPCs are the walker in other colors). Animations: 0-3 stand, 4-7 walk, 8-11 run (down, up, left, right). ECHO CAVE PREVIEW (shapes, the battle sandbox's cave backdrop) and its name text are the cave's location preview (D-17). F2: BUSH (a bush the Starter's clear action removes; one frame, every animation shows it). DS1 (D-30): sprite:NPC is a three-column direction grid (down, up, left; right mirrors left), sprite:GUARD a four-column one; door:HUT is the hut's door (three frames loaded into the map's tile area, open and close four display frames a step).
